context: Sho-young and Daichi take the shinkansen for the first time together.
purpose: Father introducing son to bullet train experience.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Wide-eyed wonder in the attack. Bright, high-pitched child's voice. Breathless pacing—each phrase tumbles out before the last one finishes. Pure delight, no filter.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: おう、めっちゃ速いやろ?
lines.en: Yeah, it really is, isn't it?
lines.style: Warm Kansai drawl, gentle and indulgent. Speaks low and easy, like he's sharing a secret. Slight smile in the voice. Slow pace—savoring his son's excitement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: The scenery's just flowing right by!
lines.style: High energy, almost gasping between phrases. Talking to himself as much as to his father. Rapid, animated. The thrill of discovery—each word pushed forward by excitement.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Kansai accent warm underneath. Quiet satisfaction—not boasting, just stating fact. Slow, contented delivery. Slight lift at the end, like giving his son a gift.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: How long until we get there?
lines.style: Soft, genuinely curious question. Mid-pace, thoughtful. The voice of a child processing the journey, not impatient—just mapping his world.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Easy informational tone. Kansai warmth underlying. Matter-of-fact but never dismissive. A father giving his son useful information without making a fuss of it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Peak brightness and energy. Child's voice at full joy. Quick, light delivery—bouncing on each word. Whole-body happiness translated into sound.
